about: Ray-marched, so slow in software (about 2 minutes a frame): ?res=0.5 and the canvas. Labels are not on the canvas. __engine.set(z, phi) poses the engine; phi is the crank angle, 0 to 720. Wait for __engine.flow (the gas paths).

sets.name: cycle-at-cylinder
sets.note: One cycle at the Cylinder stop. Expect: gas enters and leaves only through an open valve, its amount is fixed while both are shut, and the flame starts at the plug.
